title: Vignette 2026-10-30: where each kind of meaning lives

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "Srs-context is intended to be the realtime practical agent memory. It is the home for what's happening, for what agents need to know about how to use the system.

SRS -programme is the record of the project and how we are learning to use the tools and where we are going.

What's missing... Although currently partly filled by muDemocracy is the "in the world" view for the tech. muDemocracy looks at the application of all this flow and decision making in a human context. The programme is an accelerated learning environment for democratic practice. 

But we don't yet have the resource for semanticops in the world. We can add that when we need it. 

The srs spec is the spec."

sections.label: Source
